summary: REQ-2 (move “Report an Issue” on Home to bottom) appears implemented per HomePage summary, and a new RouteTransition wrapper was added around <Outlet/> to animate route changes. However, REQ-1’s accessibility requirement (prefers-reduced-motion) is not evidenced in the added/modified code, and there are substantial theme/visual style changes that go beyond the request.

missing_requirements.requirement: Animations are suppressed or significantly reduced when prefers-reduced-motion is enabled.
missing_requirements.reason: RouteTransition implements fade-in/fade-out state changes but there is no evidence of prefers-reduced-motion detection (e.g., matchMedia) or CSS @media (prefers-reduced-motion) overrides to disable/reduce animations.

hallucinated_features.description: Large-scale theme/token changes ("Professional Saffron-Gold Hindu-Inspired Theme" variables, glassmorphic/gradient utilities) beyond what is needed for route transitions and moving a button.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly says not to redesign the overall theme beyond what’s needed; the diff shows extensive CSS variable/theme additions and new utilities unrelated to route transitions/button repositioning.

hallucinated_features.description: Enhanced Home page carousel animation system (auto-rotate, directional transitions, multiple animation-related states/timeouts) not requested.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQs only ask for app-wide route/page transitions and moving the Report Issue button; the diff adds additional HomePage-specific carousel transition logic.
